notes: A local weather widget now sits on the right in line with Home and Apps, with matching rounded styling. It automatically uses the device’s approximate public-IP/ISP area and shows a condition icon, temperature and weather. Select it to change Celsius/Fahrenheit, refresh, or choose a city manually. Location follows network changes; VPNs may affect the detected area. No GPS permission is needed. Your wallpaper, branded header and app rows are retained.
